7022.title: Unregistered providers survive thread creation
7022.rootCauseOneLine: Creation defaults reject unavailable registrations but allow a missing registration, persisting an unusable provider ID.
7022.proposedFix: Reject missing provider registrations in the shared creation defaults policy before persistence, using the existing 400/invalid_request error and registered IDs.
7022.caveats: The reporter's historical version and live-thread count were not inspected. The reproduction uses a synthetic missing ID and the exact trusted main commit. Existing invalid threads are not repaired.
